title: used to / be used to / get used to

why: Три похожих конструкции выражают разное. Used to говорит о том, что раньше было постоянно, а теперь нет («раньше я, бывало...»). Be used to значит «привык, для меня это обычно». Get used to значит «привыкаю, становлюсь привыкшим».
formation: • used to + V1 (начальная форма): I used to smoke. Отрицание: didn't use to + V1. Вопрос: Did you use to ...?
• be used to + V-ing или существительное: I am used to working late. She is used to the noise.
• get used to + V-ing или существительное: I'm getting used to living alone. He got used to the cold.
• Be и get меняются по временам (am/is/are, was, have been, will get), а used to в used to + V1 всегда остаётся в прошедшем.
usage: 1. Used to + V1: привычка или состояние в прошлом, которых уже нет.
• I used to play chess every day. (Раньше я каждый день играл в шахматы.)
• We used to live in Lviv. (Мы раньше жили во Львове.)
2. Be used to + V-ing: что-то привычно, не вызывает трудностей.
• He is used to getting up early. (Он привык рано вставать.)
• I'm not used to this heat. (Я не привык к такой жаре.)
3. Get used to + V-ing: процесс привыкания.
• It was hard, but I got used to working remotely. (Было трудно, но я привык работать удалённо.)
• You'll soon get used to the new office. (Ты скоро привыкнешь к новому офису.)
signalWords: Used to: when I was a child, years ago, in the past, but now... Be/get used to: already, soon, in a month, at first, not yet, still.
mistakes: ✗ I used to working here. → ✓ I used to work here. После used to (прошлая привычка) идёт V1, а не V-ing.
✗ I'm used to get up early. → ✓ I'm used to getting up early. После be used to нужен V-ing, потому что to здесь предлог.
✗ I didn't used to like tea. → ✓ I didn't use to like tea. Вспомогательный did уже показывает прошедшее время, поэтому use без d.
✗ I used to live here now. → ✓ I live here now. / I used to live here. Used to говорит только о прошлом и не бывает для настоящего.
✗ I am used to the noise last year. → ✓ I got used to the noise last year. Для процесса привыкания в прошлом нужен get used to в Past Simple.
remember: Used to + V1 = раньше делал (теперь нет); be/get used to + V-ing или сущ. = привык / привыкаю.

items.prompt: I ___ (play) the guitar when I was young.
We ___ (live) in a small village.
She ___ (have) long hair, but now it is short.
They ___ (go) to the sea every summer.
He ___ (work) as a waiter before he became a developer.
My grandfather ___ (tell) us stories every evening.
I ___ (be) afraid of dogs.
We ___ (not / have) a car, but now we do.
I'm used to (a) get up (b) getting up early.
She used to (a) walk (b) walking to school.
It took me a month to get used to (a) work (b) working at night.
He isn't used to (a) the cold (b) be cold in the north.
Did you use to (a) play (b) playing video games?
I'll never get used to (a) wake up (b) waking up at 5 a.m.
They are used to (a) travel (b) travelling a lot for work.
We (a) didn't used to (b) didn't use to eat out much.

exercises.instruction: Заполните пропуск (used to / be used to / get used to + глагол в нужной форме)

items.prompt: I ___ (not / be) used to the noise yet. It's very loud here.
He ___ (use) to play tennis, but he stopped after the injury.
It was difficult, but she quickly ___ used to the new job.
Don't worry. You will soon get used to ___ (drive) on the left.
My sister ___ used to living alone. She has done it for years.
When I was a child, I ___ to believe in ghosts.
After a few weeks, we ___ used to the climate.
I'm used to ___ (code) in the evenings; it's my usual time.
I used to working in a bank.
items.answer: I used to work in a bank.

items.prompt: She is used to get up at six.
items.answer: She is used to getting up at six.

items.prompt: Did you used to live in Odesa?
items.answer: Did you use to live in Odesa?

items.prompt: I'm not used to spicy food last year.
items.answer: I wasn't used to spicy food last year. / I didn't get used to spicy food last year.

items.prompt: He didn't used to smoke.
We are getting used to live in a big city.
items.answer: We are getting used to living in a big city.

items.prompt: I used to drink coffee every day, and I still do.
items.answer: I drink coffee every day. / I used to drink coffee every day, but I don't now.

items.prompt: They get used to the new rules in a week ago.
items.answer: They got used to the new rules a week ago.

items.answer: I used to live in a small town.

items.prompt: Я привык вставать в семь утра.
items.answer: I am used to getting up at seven a.m. / I'm used to getting up at seven a.m. / I am used to waking up at seven a.m.

items.prompt: Мне трудно привыкнуть к новому графику.
items.answer: It is hard for me to get used to the new schedule. / I find it hard to get used to the new schedule. / I'm finding it hard to get used to the new schedule.

items.prompt: Раньше он не любил кофе.
items.answer: He didn't use to like coffee. / He used not to like coffee.

items.prompt: Она привыкла работать удалённо.
items.answer: She is used to working remotely. / She's used to working from home.

items.prompt: Ты скоро привыкнешь к этому городу.
items.answer: You will soon get used to this city. / You'll soon get used to this city.

items.prompt: Мы раньше часто ходили в кино.
items.answer: We used to go to the cinema a lot. / We used to go to the movies a lot. / We used to go to the cinema often.

items.prompt: Я не привык к такой жаре.
items.answer: I am not used to this heat. / I'm not used to such heat. / I'm not used to this kind of heat.
